title: Excalibur/Prime
extract:
Release Date: December 18th, 2012
 Excalibur Prime is the Primed variant of  Excalibur, possessing higher armor and energy, as well as an additional  polarity and a  Aura polarity. Excalibur Prime is a Founders-exclusive Warframe released alongside  Lato Prime and  Skana Prime.

Acquisition
Excalibur Prime was only obtainable by upgrading a Warframe account to Founders status of Hunter or greater, which is no longer available. He came with his own Warframe slot and was already augmented with an Orokin Reactor.
The Founders' program closed on the 1st of November, 2013, as announced on the Warframe Forums. This closure is inclusive of pack upgrades.

Notes
 Excalibur Prime, compared to  Excalibur:
Higher Armor (315 vs. 240)
Higher Energy (175/225 vs. 100/150)
Higher Starting Energy (100 vs. 50)
Additional  Polarity ( vs. )
Different Aura Polarity ( vs. None)
 Excalibur Prime, compared to  Excalibur Umbra:
Different Polarities ( vs. )
As with any other Prime Warframe, moving close to the location of an Orokin Void Death Orb will restore a pulse of 250 Energy to nearby allies, even if that Death Orb is inactive, destroyed, or non-present. This effect can only occur once per orb.
Due to having the base stats of Umbra but without the problems of Umbra’s Sentience,  Excalibur Prime is uniquely capable of running certain builds which may require the higher base stats and an Exilus slot where  Warrior's Rest is required.
Duplicate versions of  Excalibur Prime are not obtainable.

Trivia
Excalibur Prime is the first Prime Warframe in the game.
He is also the first Prime Warframe to come with two different polarities, as opposed to one. This was followed by  Ember Prime and  Loki Prime.
There is a statue of Excalibur Prime inside the Orokin Vaults on Deimos, and one of the Lua Spy vaults.
Interestingly, at the start of Update 11.0 (2013-11-20) Excalibur Prime was given a short-lived full body skin called "Alabaster", which was explained by Digital Extremes as a test skin that was released by mistake. The skin's texture was similar to Orokin Vault statues.
Compared to the later prime Warframes, Excalibur Prime has the least cosmetic difference compared to his standard counterpart, with the only significant additions being the Void Key-shaped emblem on his helmet and golden blades along his forearms.
When he was released, it was widely believed that Excalibur Prime had a slightly higher shield recharge rate compared to the non-prime variant.
While the existence of this feature can neither be confirmed, nor denied, Excalibur Prime currently does not possess this stat change.
Much like how Update 14.0 (2014-07-18) gave the standard Excalibur an ethereal  Skana when using his abilities, Excalibur Prime uses an ethereal  Skana Prime with his abilities, which was also added in the same update.
On the Chinese build of Warframe, Excalibur Umbra Prime serves as a stand-in for Excalibur Prime.
During the events of The Old Peace quest, Excalibur Prime is temporarily playable throughout most of the quest.
If the player owned Excalibur Prime, it will use the Config A appearance for the quest.
